outcome: clinical manifestations of CP (gross- and fine-motor function, speech impairments, epilepsy, vision impairment, hearing impairment)
cohort: Children with congenital cerebral palsy born at or later than 34 weeks' gestation in Norway between 1999 and 2009.
finding: Children with cerebral palsy and congenital anomalies had more severe limitations in motor function and more associated problems despite less frequent low Apgar scores, compared to children with CP without anomalies.
cross-section timing: Children born between 1999 and 2009, with data collected from national registries.
